STEP 1 - Scene: A lunch plate with a meat portion (looks like seared/roasted meat slices), a chicken or tuna-style salad with dressing, a mixed green salad (arugula/leafy greens with red-tinged leaves), and roasted eggplant or vegetable pieces. Photographed from above, roughly top-down, on a glass table.

STEP 2 - Ruler: Square white plate, about 26 cm across its longest side. Area ≈ 26 × 26 × ~0.85 (rounded corners) ≈ 575 cm²; I'll use ~550 cm² of usable plate surface.

STEP 3 - Items:
- Seared/roasted meat slices (pinkish, with browned edges)
- Chicken or fish salad in creamy dressing (with some red onion/herb bits)
- Mixed leafy greens (arugula-type with red stems)
- Roasted eggplant/vegetable cubes

STEP 4 - Area (of ~550 cm² plate):
- Meat slices 14% = 77 cm² × 1.0 cm = 77 ml × 0.9 = 69 g
- Chicken salad 18% = 99 cm² × 2.0 cm = 198 ml × 0.9 = 178 g
- Mixed leaves 28% = 154 cm² × 2.5 cm = 385 ml × 0.15 = 58 g
- Roasted vegetable cubes 8% = 44 cm² × 1.5 cm = 66 ml × 0.6 = 40 g
Food covers ~68% of the plate.

STEP 5-6 - Grams: as listed above, totaling about 345 g.

STEP 7 - Energy:
- Meat slices: 69 g × 200 kcal/100g ≈ 138 kcal (pork/beef, moderate fat)
- Chicken salad with dressing: 178 g × 180 kcal/100g ≈ 320 kcal
- Mixed leaves: 58 g × 25 kcal/100g ≈ 15 kcal
- Roasted vegetables (eggplant, some oil): 40 g × 100 kcal/100g ≈ 40 kcal
Total ≈ 513 kcal.

STEP 8 - Sanity check: A two-thirds-covered dinner plate with a protein-heavy salad and leaves at ~345 g and ~500 kcal is plausible for a single meal.
